description: Image Description: The image depicts a kitchen corner featuring a stainless steel refrigerator with a built-in water and ice dispenser. Adjacent to the refrigerator is a countertop with a wooden surface, and there is a pink object placed on it. Below the countertop, there are white cabinets with silver handles. To the left of the cabinets, a dishwasher is visible. Above the countertop and dishwasher, there are white wall-mounted cabinets. The floor appears to be dark hardwood. The walls are painted in a warm beige color
